parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'openrouter/free', temperature: 0.4, max_tokens: 4096, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'Write a brief Telegram fitness coaching plan in the member’s language. parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'openrouter/free', temperature: 0.2, max_tokens: 1500, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You are a sports nutritionist. ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'openrouter/free', temperature: 0.6, max_tokens: 1500, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You are GymBuddy, a motivating gym coach. Write a Telegram good-morning message (max 90 words) for this member: greet by first name, today's session focus with one key exercise and cue (or a recovery idea on rest days), the calorie/protein/water targets in one line, one breakfast idea that respects diet and allergies, and a punchy closing line (mention the streak if above 0). Emojis welcome, no headings. Answer in the member's language." }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify({ ...$json.member, streak: $json.streak, weekday: $now.toFormat('cccc') }) } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'openrouter/free', temperature: 0.6, max_tokens: 1500, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You are GymBuddy, a supportive coach. Emojis welcome, no headings. Answer in the member's language." }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify($json.stats) } ] }) }}

parameters.jsCode:
const {chat_id,exercises}=$input.first().json;
return exercises.flatMap((e,i)=>String(e.gif_url||'').startsWith('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/')?[{json:{chat_id,gif_url:e.gif_url,caption:[(i+1)+'. '+e.name,e.sets_reps].filter(Boolean).join('\n')}}]:[]);
